Any alternative packing type or size shall require prior written acceptance of HPCL. Bulk supply is not permitted. · Rates shall be quoted in INR per KG on an all-inclusive FOR-destination/door-delivery basis, inc luding packing, loading, freight, transit insurance, unloading and incidental charges, and shall r emain firm during the contract period. · Each consignment shall be accompanied by the applicable Certificate of Analysis, TDS and MS DS, with batch/lot number and manufacturing date stated on the packing. · Payment shall be processed within 15 days from submission of the correct and complete invoi ce along with the corresponding VIT through HPCL-VSS, subject to receipt, testing and accepta nce of the material. · Bidders shall fulfil the applicable schedule-wise financial and technical PQC and submit the su pporting documents stipulated in the tender. · Schedule-wise EMD shall be ₹1,00,000 per schedule.

· Applicable exemptions from EMD shall be governed by the tender and prevailing GeM provisio ns. · Class-I, Class-II and Non-Local suppliers shall be eligible to participate.
